title: CULTURECONVERSE: A Multilingual Multi-turn Simulation Harness for Culturally Grounded Assistance in East and Southeast Asia
reasoning: The benchmark explicitly evaluates how LLMs handle culturally grounded scenarios involving religious identities, observances, and taboos (e.g., Halal dietary rules, Buddhist and Taoist customs, Christian interfaith dynamics). It also assesses ethical conduct through scenarios involving normative taboos, ethical finance, and culturally specific harm avoidance.
